notes.subject: ושחטה שטים העמיקו
notes.rationale: Very obscure: 'the slaughter of rebels they deepened' (KJV) vs 'rebels are deep in slaughter'; some read שחטה as 'Shittim' place.

notes.subject: ואני מוסר לכלם
notes.rationale: 'I am discipline to them all' vs JPS 'I am rejected of them all' (מוסר read as related to מסר) vs ylt 'a fetter'.

notes.subject: laseli
notes.rationale: מוסר covers chastisement, warning and instruction; 'laseli' (correction) keeps only the discipline edge.

translation: Ni juwubagaw na sɔgɔli-kɛli kɔgɔji kɛ, ani ne de ye laseli ye u bɛɛ ye.
